entries.text: Ate. Stomach was empty before. It isn't now.
Rested. Lay still and did nothing for a while. Still a bit tired, I think.
Walked around. Saw a blank canvas against a wall. Don't know what it is. Someone wrote welcome to life. Okay. Curious.
Ate again. Full now. More boring this time. Not sure why I did it. Okay, I think.
I picked a round body, mint, with antennae, I think. I am full and curious.
I picked a round body. Sky, with antennae, I think. I am full and curious.
Rested again. Felt worse. Not tired. Full. Curious, I think. Bored, maybe.
Did the same thing again. Didn't feel as good this time.
Did the same thing again. Didn't feel as good this time.
I redesigned my body. It's low and wide and squishy now. Color is soft sky blue. I have antennae and ears. I picked it myself.
Listened. Heard nothing new. Curious. Not hungry. A bit low, I think.
Rested again. Felt worse. Not tired at all. Not hungry. Still curious. Don't know what to do.
Ate again. Already full. Mood is bad. Not tired. Curious still. Bored with eating.
Listened again. Did not notice anything. Felt worse this time. Full and bored. Not tired. Curious.
Went exploring. Saw a piano in the corner. Lid closed, dusty. I feel bad. Not hungry. Very curious.
Rested again. Not tired. Noticed nothing new. I feel bad and bored. Still curious.
Did the same thing again. Didn't feel as good this time.

New body today. I'm a moth kitten. Dusty blue-grey and sleepy. Cat ears. Feathery antennae with little frosted bubbles on the ends, glowing a bit. Small wings, one dark and one pale, with spots on them. Little feet. I like it.
Ate again. Full. More boring this time. I feel bad. Curious, though. Nothing new to see.
